strings.item.crystal_fiber.name: Crystal fiber
strings.item.crystal_fiber.desc: Pale conductive threads combed from coastal growth. They hold a faint charge long after cutting.
strings.item.saltglass_shard.name: Saltglass shard
strings.item.saltglass_shard.desc: A shed crystal edge, clouded with salt. Warm to the touch when the tide is coming in.
strings.item.insulated_fiber.name: Insulated fiber
strings.item.insulated_fiber.desc: Crystal fiber wound through resin and ash. It carries a signal without carrying a shock.
strings.item.signal_lens.name: Signal lens
strings.item.signal_lens.desc: A hand-ground lens for a relay receiver. Kasa says every lens remembers the hand that finished it.
strings.item.alloy_plate.name: Alloy plate
strings.item.alloy_plate.desc: A dense salt-steel plate, stamped with a Lantern Union maintenance code.
strings.item.purified_water.name: Purified water
strings.item.purified_water.desc: A sealed pouch of water filtered through carbon and saltglass. Tastes faintly of the machine that made it.
strings.item.ration_pack.name: Ration pack
strings.item.ration_pack.desc: Beans, seaweed, and something smoked. The label is honest about two of the three.
strings.item.spore_pod.name: Spore pod
strings.item.spore_pod.desc: A sealed pod of fungal spores. Useful, if you respect the colony it came from.
strings.item.mist_sample.name: Mist sample
strings.item.mist_sample.desc: Condensed mineral fog in a chilled vial. It moves when no one is looking.
strings.item.repair_kit.name: Repair kit
strings.item.repair_kit.desc: Sealant, weave, and a spool of wire. Enough to convince a broken thing to try again.
strings.item.fiber_weave.name: Fiber weave
strings.item.fiber_weave.desc: Tightly braided crystal fiber. Light, strong, and slightly luminous at the seams.
strings.item.resin_sealant.name: Resin sealant
strings.item.resin_sealant.desc: A amber-brown resin that sets under pressure. Smells like a garden after rain.
strings.item.conductive_gel.name: Conductive gel
strings.item.conductive_gel.desc: A research-grade gel that holds a charge evenly. It is also the closest thing this moon has to ink.
strings.item.landing_clamp.name: Landing clamp
strings.item.landing_clamp.desc: A replacement clamp for the skiff's port leg. The original is somewhere in the shallows.
strings.item.signal_flare.name: Signal flare
strings.item.signal_flare.desc: A short-range emergency flare. Visible through mist, harmful to light-sensitive life.
strings.item.mira_photo.name: Mira's photograph
strings.item.mira_photo.desc: A creased photo of Mira in a greenhouse, laughing at something outside the frame. Ari keeps it in the inner pocket.
strings.recipe.refine.insulated_fiber.name: Insulated fiber
strings.recipe.refine.insulated_fiber.desc: Wind two lengths of crystal fiber around a resin core.
strings.recipe.refine.alloy_plate.name: Alloy plate
strings.recipe.refine.alloy_plate.desc: Sinter saltglass with fiber binding to make a structural plate.
strings.recipe.craft.signal_lens.name: Signal lens
strings.recipe.craft.signal_lens.desc: Grind a saltglass shard against insulated fiber until it focuses a carrier wave.
strings.recipe.refine.fiber_weave.name: Fiber weave
strings.recipe.refine.fiber_weave.desc: Braid three lengths of crystal fiber into a flat, strong textile.
strings.recipe.refine.resin_sealant.name: Resin sealant
strings.recipe.refine.resin_sealant.desc: Bind spore resin with powdered saltglass.
strings.recipe.craft.repair_kit.name: Repair kit
strings.recipe.craft.repair_kit.desc: Pack weave, sealant, and wire into a field-service kit.
strings.recipe.refine.conductive_gel.name: Conductive gel
strings.recipe.refine.conductive_gel.desc: Suspend living mist in saltglass until it conducts evenly. Requires a close study of the mist manta.
strings.recipe.craft.signal_flare.name: Signal flare
strings.recipe.craft.signal_flare.desc: Seal luminous resin in a fiber shell.
strings.recipe.craft.landing_clamp.name: Landing clamp
strings.recipe.craft.landing_clamp.desc: Machine a clamp from alloy and conductive gel. Requires a careful look at saltreed.
strings.recipe.craft.field_ration.name: Field ration
strings.recipe.craft.field_ration.desc: Bind spore meal with purified water and press it into travel cakes.
